headline: Apple, Steel Dynamics, CBRE Group And More: CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
summary: Kevin Simpson chose Steel Dynamics as his final trade, supported by strong Q2 sales. Stephen Weiss recommended U.S. 10 Year Treasury, Joseph Terranova picked Apple ahead of earnings, and Bryn Talkington chose CBRE Group with better-than-expected earnings results.
